items.title: Formal smoothness of the source makes the conormal-against-differentials sequence short exact on spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For h : Z -> X formally unramified over B with Z formally smooth over B, the canonical sequence 0 -> C_{Z/X} -> h^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B} -> 0 of the chapter's differentials-sequence lemma (same wave, L16226) is short exact. The retained proof is complete: identify the sequence, as done in that lemma's proof, with C_{Z/Z'} -> Omega_{Z'/B} (x) O_Z -> Omega_{Z/B} -> 0 for the universal first order thickening Z'; formal smoothness of Z over B produces, etale-locally on Z', a left inverse Z' -> Z over B to the closed inclusion (the standard splitting of a first order thickening by a formal-smooth diagonal lifting); the differentials sequence for a split relative immersion (chapter lemma differentials-relative-immersion-section) is then exact on the left etale-locally, hence exact. Retained author proof at lines 5000-5013.
